sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- IRGC statement, Fri Nov 6, via IRNA/Press TV] Iran's IRGC Aerospace Force intercepted and destroyed a US MQ-1 reconnaissance-combat drone over Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz using an advanced air defence system under Iran's integrated air defence network. The IRGC describes this as the 16th US MQ-1 drone shot down. The IRGC said Wednesday it had downed the 15th MQ-1 over Qeshm. [ATTRIBUTED -- Tribune PK / IRNA] IRGC figures claim 16 MQ-1s and 56 MQ-9s downed in total, i.e. 72 aircraft of the two types. Earlier Friday the IRGC also said it brought down two US MQM-170 reconnaissance drones over Qeshm Island (IRNA via Tribune PK); Iran previously said it downed four MQM-170s in the Strait area during the conflict. [CONTEXT -- Shafaq] The US struck targets on Qeshm Island on Nov 2 in a 'limited' operation, a US official told Reuters. AJ liveblog: 'Tehran's intensified diplomatic push comes after Iran downed two US reconnaissance drones near Qeshm Island... which the US struck earlier this week.'
sections.what_verified: 3 distinct publisher families carry the IRGC statement: IRNA / Press TV (T3, STATE IR -- one registry family) + Al Jazeera (T2, STATE QA, liveblog relay of Fars) + Jerusalem Post (T3, carrying Iranian media/IRGC). Shafaq, LBC, APA, Tribune PK and Sunday Guardian carry the same claim but have NO declared tier in the registry and do not count toward corroboration. The statement is confirmed; the event is not.
sections.what_disputed: No immediate confirmation from the United States (Reuters via JPost; LBC; Dawn). The IRGC statement does not specify the exact time of the incident or the type of missile used (Press TV). No wreckage, video or independent imagery has surfaced. The Nov 3 MQM-170 claim (recorded 0100-04) likewise drew no CENTCOM response; CENTCOM denials on record cover the Oct 29 MQM-170 and September Remus 600 claims, not this one. The 16 + 56 = 72 cumulative figure is the IRGC's own count, never independently audited.
sections.why_matters: Iran says it just shot down its 16th American drone over the Strait — and Washington has said nothing at all. The silence is the story.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (IRNA published 14:36Z = 18:36 ; Press TV 14:40 GMT = 18:40 ; JPost 15:46; zero 'MQ-1' mentions in any prior Nov 6 scan -- grep confirms) -- IRGC says it shot down the 16th US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz; two MQM-170s also claimed downed Friday

totw_analysis: Our read: Iran says it just shot down its 16th American drone over the Strait — and Washington has said nothing at all. The silence is the story. The fault line our audience is arguing over: 16 drones down — or 16 press releases? If the US really lost a 16th MQ-1 over Qeshm, where is the wreckage?
